NewsArticle.Title: Clear Passage
NewsArticle.Content:
Mundanes react to a rash of rotten Aislings blocking passages, teaching the skill 'Throw.' Throw moves an Aisling one pace back. If the pace behind the Aisling is a portal, the player is transported through.
Bodil in Abel teaches Throw to rogues and monks. Guards learn Throw when beginning their term.
